channel.title: Korea Small & Mid-Cap Filings
channel.description: Daily English summaries of material Korean small and mid-cap filings. Facts only, not investment advice.

item.title: Korea Small & Mid-Cap Filings, 20 Nov 2026
item.description: Yooshin signed a KRW 63.6bn (636억원) contract for feasibility study and FEED design consulting on five Hanoi urban rail lines in Vietnam. / Dongbu Corporation signed a KRW 140.2bn contract with Seoul Housing & Communities Corporation for the Jangji Garage Multi-level Development construction. / Kumho Engineering & Construction signed a KRW 175.3bn (1,753억원) contract with Seoul Housing & Communities Corporation for the Jangji depot multi-level development construction.

item.title: Korea Small & Mid-Cap Filings, 9 Nov 2026
item.description: Organic Tea Cosmetics decided on a third-party allotment of 50,000,000 new common shares at KRW 2,025 each, raising KRW 101.25bn. / Dasco signed a KRW 32.4bn (323억원) service contract to manage and operate the Sin Dasan Energy solar power project. / Incon signed a KRW 5.46bn (54.6억원) LTE-R upgrade works contract with Korea Rail Network Authority, equal to 10.74% of revenue.

item.title: Korea Small & Mid-Cap Filings, 6 Nov 2026
item.description: Kyeryong Construction Industrial won a KRW 97.6bn (976억원) order for the Southwest Comprehensive Sports Town sports facility construction in Daejeon. / KGA signed a KRW 2.8bn (28억원) logistics automation equipment supply contract, equal to 15.45% of recent revenue, with delivery through July 31, 2027. / TC Materials decided to issue KRW 30.0bn (300억원) in second-series private convertible bonds, with a conversion price of KRW 4,290 per share.

item.title: Korea Small & Mid-Cap Filings, 5 Nov 2026
item.description: Dongsung Finetec signed a KRW 192.3bn (1,923억원) contract to supply cryogenic insulation materials for LNG carriers to HD Hyundai Heavy Industries. / HB Solution signed a KRW 15.6bn equipment supply contract with Chengdu BOE Display Technology for delivery in China. / Taesung's board resolved on Nov 5, 2026 to issue KRW 70.0bn (700억원) of 0% private-placement convertible bonds due Nov 19, 2031.

item.title: Korea Small & Mid-Cap Filings, 4 Nov 2026
item.description: Sundo Electric signed a KRW 8.85bn (88.498억원) installation contract with SK hynix for the Yongin Y1 Ph-2 MCC/MCP project. / EcoGlow's board decided on Nov 4, 2026 a public paid-in capital increase of 1,031,282 new common shares at KRW 2,909 each. / FSN decided to issue KRW 3.0bn (30억원) of Series 16 private convertible bonds for working capital, maturing 12 November 2029.

item.title: Korea Small & Mid-Cap Filings, 3 Nov 2026
item.description: Bitmax decided a third-party allotment of 13,961,520 new common shares to Korea Advanced Materials for an in-kind contribution of KRW 21.6bn. / Ilsung Construction disclosed termination of a KRW 47.9bn construction contract after the counterparty gave notice of cancellation on 2026-08-12. / Hanwool N Jeju decided on a public offering of 3,599,929 new common shares at a tentative KRW 611 per share to fund operations.

item.title: Korea Small & Mid-Cap Filings, 2 Nov 2026
item.description: Kwangjin Industrial's board resolved on 2 Nov 2026 to issue KRW 10.0bn (100억원) of Series 5 private convertible bonds, due 16 Nov 2029. / Sempio Foods filed a merger securities registration statement to issue 4,208,546 common shares totaling KRW 88.6bn (88,589,893,300원). / Sundo Electric signed a KRW 6.34bn contract with Korea Rail Network Authority for 29kV eco-friendly switchgear on the Honam High-Speed Railway Phase 2.
